name: How much does it typically cost to upgrade a garage interior in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: How much does it typically cost to upgrade a garage interior in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a garage interior upgrade in Daly City varies significantly based on the scope and materials. Basic upgrades like an epoxy floor coating might start around $1,500 - $3,000 for a two-car garage. Adding custom storage solutions can range from $2,000 to $10,000 or more, depending on the complexity and materials chosen. For a full garage conversion, including insulation, drywall, electrical work, and flooring, costs can easily exceed $15,000 - $30,000. It's best to get a detailed quote tailored to your specific project needs.
